name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.income.view.WithdrawActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this page when the user starts a withdrawal. It loads available balances and bank cards, calculates fees, collects the amount and verification details, and submits the withdrawal request.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from requesting a withdrawal.
